name: Bell Borca, Spectral Sergeant — the greatest number noted this turn is a typed-in value
notes: 'Bell Borca's power is equal to the greatest number noted for it this turn' gave no effect. The site keeps no record of when a card was exiled or of the numbers noted, so the number is typed into the card's value box (userAdjustable + isChosenAmount, power only). With 6 typed Bell Borca is 6/5; untyped it is 0/5 (no number noted). Grizzly Bears beside it stays 2/2.
